task: Is this export complete, what evidence supports that, and what should happen next?

baseline.description: The retained human metadata/status view with progress off. A adds the reused progress region; B/C explore further changes. The machine harness is new and evaluated separately.

options.label: A · Reuse
options.hypothesis: A familiar compact Cloud composition lets users correctly identify completion with minimal new interaction.
reuse: Export task identity, authoritative lifecycle and the same worker observations.
changes: Add the established compact progress row to the baseline metadata.

capabilities.name: Agent consumes Export
capabilities.hypothesis: A machine can determine authoritative task state and justify the next action from structured evidence.
limitations: Local synthetic fixtures only; no hosted API, MCP server or production permission check.

options.label: B · Evolve
options.hypothesis: One evidence-grounded next-action summary reduces uncertainty without changing the familiar task-detail hierarchy.
reuse: Export task identity, authoritative lifecycle and the same worker observations.
changes: Add a concise state-aware summary and next safe action.
Keep unknowns, stale observations and Export lifecycle explicit.

capabilities.name: Agent consumes Export
capabilities.hypothesis: A machine can determine authoritative task state and justify the next action from structured evidence.
limitations: Local synthetic fixtures only; no hosted API, MCP server or production permission check.

capabilities.name: Contextual interpretation
capabilities.hypothesis: A bounded summary can improve decision accuracy.
limitations: No AI model; no failure cause, ETA or delivery confirmation is inferred.

options.label: C · Explore
options.hypothesis: A goal-oriented, inspectable handoff can reduce coordination effort while preserving justified decisions.
reuse: Export task identity, authoritative lifecycle and the same worker observations.
changes: Organize around current situation, desired outcome, proposed next step and evidence.
Require inspection and explicit approval of the current proposal; allow correction and dismissal.

limitations: Local synthetic fixtures only; no hosted API, MCP server or production permission check.

capabilities.name: AI-enabled handoff planning
capabilities.hypothesis: AI could synthesize task evidence into a verifiable next-step plan.
dependencies: Authorized task inspection and execution adapter
limitations: Deterministic replay only; no model call.
